data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement deep-tier CI flow: 3 parallel sonnet litellm calls (deep-correctness, deep-verification, deep-hygiene) followed by a single opus litellm call with deep-arch.md as system prompt over merged outputs. Create plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-vs-local-parity-scope.md documenting the dispatch-architecture delta and fidelity tolerance acceptance criterion.
**Why**: CI cannot use the Agent tool to dispatch sub-agents; this approximation captures the same prompts via litellm. The contract makes the approximation explicit so future readers understand the parity scope.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - Deep-tier dispatch.py path runs 3 sonnets + 1 opus arch via litellm
  - ci-vs-local-parity-scope.md created with dispatch delta documented
  - Fidelity tolerance acceptance criterion: CI deep-tier verdict within one severity band of local on fixture PRs (per S15)
  OUT:
  - Single-tier reviewer dispatch (S1)
  - Validation against fixtures (S15)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CI deep-tier review runs the 3+1 approximation and the parity-scope contract is in place
  ← Satisfies: "Single source of truth for review prompts (CI parity)"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] If fixture divergence exceeds one-severity-band tolerance, Phase 1 rolls back per the parity-scope contract

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a deep-tier CI review, I approximate opus arch synthesis via single opus call over merged sonnet specialist outputs and document the dispatch-architecture delta
